text:
Lina (AE): HeliosCap just emailed an RFI. They want a capability matrix, answers to an 60-qa security workbook, EU data residency proof, and a 2-week POC plan they can run. Deadline: close of business tomorrow.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Can you attach their workbook? need to check questions around model self-hosting and batch sizes.
Lina (AE): Uploaded: https://drive.internal/helioscap-rfi-2026.pdf - top asks: embeddings at scale, reranking, redaction, and HSM-backed keys.
Priya (Sales Eng): Quick commercial thought: two pilot flavors — (A) Hosted API pilot (no infra commit) w/ token credits, (B) Private VPC pilot w/ 2 reserved instances for predictable latency. Ballpark monthly: A =~ $6k (credits), B =~ $16k (reserve + ops).
Ethan (Security): They specifically ask for HSM audit hooks and certs for the EU region. We have KMS integrations (AWS/GCP) and a BYOK flow; HSM audit-level integration is currently scoped as an SOW. We can deliver logs to their SIEM via syslog/forwarder during POC.
Nina (Legal): For the RFI, include SOC2 Type II date and our standard DPA. Don't promise HSM delivery timelines in the RFI; state "available as SOW". Also flag the indemnity clause they included — we'll propose carving model-output indemnities to mutual indemnity.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Technical POC suggestion: ingest pipeline -> hosted embeddings service -> dedicated reranker endpoint. For EU residency, use Private (VPC) deployed into eu-central-1 with customer-managed KMS. Recommend sample config and a small ingress container for their data filter.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Paste example ingress snippet:
```
# minimal ingress docker-compose for POC
version: '3.7'
services:
  filter-ingest:
    image: redwood/ingest:stable
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_API=https://private.eu.redwood.io
      - KMS_URI=aws-kms://arn:aws:kms:eu:111:key/xyz
    ports:
      - "9090:8080"
```
Asha (Customer Success): I'll own the eval criteria. Proposed KPIs: embedding recall@10 > 0.85 on their sample dataset, rerank NDCG@10 delta +0.12 vs baseline, 95th percentile latency < 200ms for 256-token context.
Priya (Sales Eng): For pricing sheet I'll produce two options with line-items: reserve cost, streaming cost, POC engineering SOW (hours), and optional HSM integration SOW. Will include a refundable pilot credit if they sign annual within 30 days.
Lina (AE): Need a short capability matrix row for the RFI: streaming, function-calling, embeddings, rerank, redaction, model pinning, quantization. Keep it terse — the procurement team likes tables.
Marco (Solutions Eng): I'll generate CSV rows with Yes/No + notes. Example: "Redaction: yes (regex+ML redaction plugin; configurable rules)".
Ethan (Security): Add these to the security answers: data at rest encryption algorithm (AES-256-GCM), in-transit TLS 1.2+, key rotation cadence options, and where audit logs are retained (90 days default, extended on request).
Nina (Legal): Timeline: I can provide DPA + standard SOW template in 48 hours. Any bespoke security wording will push the timeline; call out in RFI that "custom contract requests may add 2-3 weeks".
Lina (AE): OK action items: Marco -> capability matrix CSV + ingress snippet (EOD). Priya -> pricing options + pilot SOW (tomorrow AM). Nina -> DPA + SOW template (48hrs). Ethan -> security answer bullets + retention policy. Asha -> eval metrics and sample prompts. I'll collate and send back to HeliosCap procurement. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: release redwood-service-3.1 deployed to prod (sha: 9a12c4) :white_check_mark:
Marco (Solutions Eng): CSV and short notes uploaded: capability_matrix_helioscap_v1.csv
Priya (Sales Eng): Pricing sheet uploaded: helioscap_pilot_pricing_v1.xlsx
Lina (AE): Thanks everyone — ping me if anything blocks. I'll attach the docs to the RFI reply. :mailbox_with_mail:
